description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

Your deluded mind believes that you are o noble, maybe even royal, lineage. Choose the family name and status you believe you are born to. You will adopt the attitude and mannerism of someone of high station, as well as the trappings if you can afford them. You’ll go any length to rationalise your supposedly @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.1IVGksL10N7GVrw3]{Noble Blood}. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.x8g3U68oi8XzWiYr]{Commanding Presence} Talent. You gain 1 @Condition[Fatigued] Condition if you act beneath your imaginary station. You can’t get this mutation if you are an actual noble and you can only gain this mutation once.
